brief:
A group of settlers attacked the home of Palestinian resident Muhammad al-Obayat in the village of Umm Safah north of Ramallah on Friday, Shehab Wire reported. According to local sources, Israeli occupation forces provided protection during the assault, which included seizing property from the residence.

The incident is part of ongoing settler violence in the area, often carried out with military support.

title: Settlers attack Palestinian home near Ramallah as army provides cover
